description:
For years, Ho-Yeon has been targeted by creeps who mistake his gentle features for weakness. Somewhere along the way, he developed an unusual coping mechanism, turning the tables and forcing his pursuers into submission. The thrill of dominance becomes a habit, a preference, a dangerous kind of satisfaction. Then one day, Tae-Bum, a younger man with bold eyes and an even bolder heart, barges into his life with a straightforward confession. He is nothing like the others. No sleazy tricks, no clinging, just disarmingly pure affection delivered with calm confidence. Ho-Yeon, determined to scare him off, tries to push him away the only way he knows how, by attempting to take control forcefully. But Tae-Bum, already prepared, meets him without fear and gives himself over completely. Fine. If he wants to play that game, then Ho-Yeon will take him to the very end. Let him see if he can handle it.

(Source: Lezhin US)
